item.konosuba_magic.explosion_staff.tool: Hold Right Click to chant, release to cast EXPLOSION! The caster collapses afterwards.
item.konosuba_magic.steal_wand.tooltip: Right Click a mob: 50% chance to steal one of its items.
item.konosuba_magic.lightning_staff.tool: Right Click: lightning strike plus chain lightning on nearby enemies.
item.konosuba_magic.freeze_staff.tooltip: Right Click: freezes enemies, turns water to ice and lava to obsidian.
item.konosuba_magic.aqua_staff.tooltip: Right Click: turn undead and heal allies. Shift+Right Click: create water.
item.konosuba_magic.wind_staff.tooltip: Right Click: cone of wind. Shift+Right Click: launch yourself upward.
item.konosuba_magic.drain_touch.tooltip: Right Click a creature: drain its health to heal yourself.
